paragraphs.text: Spider is a creature type used for cards that depict arachnids, most of which spin webs that serve as nests and as traps for prey. In the Magic Multiverse . Spiders mainly appear in green , at common , and typically have a high toughness and reach .

The first creature to bear the type was Giant Spider in Alpha . Other examples include Woolly Spider from Ice Age and Deadly Recluse from Magic 2010 . For a long time, spiders were not known for typal effects, but a few rewarded playing many spiders starting from Ishkanah, Grafwidow in 2016.

Spiders are regular foes on Dominaria . Urza 's "screaming spider" artifacts sent very high sound waves that humans couldn't hear but were deadly loud to sleeper agents . In Estark , Gromashian spiderwebs were used to against trespassers. The Hurloon minotaur Eusomoné was summoned by Jared Carthalion to fight off one of Ravidel 's giant spiders in Arathoxia .
Lorwyn spiderwigs are a mass of arachnids intended to be worn rather than eaten ( Spiderwig Boggart ).

On Theros live the Aracnir , creatures whose lower torso is the abdomen of a spider complete with six arachnoid legs and whose upper torso is that of a humanoid spider with two humanoid arms and a spider-like head ( Chainweb Aracnir ).
The planeswalker Feroz and the Anaba minotaur Sandruu once fought a Root Spider .

Marvel's Spider-Man (and the Universes Within Through the Omenpaths ) takes perhaps the most iconic Marvel character and focuses on its characters and franchise, with a large selection of Human Spiders across all colors, most of which were also Heroes. It also introduced broader Spider typal (most cards that care about Spiders are from this set) and a thematic keyword in web-slinging .
